title: fix(plugin-security, lint): a refused controlled_by_parent write names no master to a writer who cannot read the master reference
body:
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:主从(`controlled_by_parent`)明细的写入被主记录编辑权拒绝时,对读不到主记录引用字段的用户,拒绝语句改为通用规则句(不点名主对象、主记录和哪一道检查);能读该字段的用户保持原文。另加一条 lint 警告,提示作者某权限集隐藏了明细的主记录引用字段。
- 为什么改:按维护者裁决,判定仍以存储的主记录为准,但对看不到引用字段的用户,拒绝文字不应透露该字段指向什么;作者隐藏该字段时也应知道它仍决定写入、用户只会看到通用拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:谁被允许、谁被拒绝不变,状态码与错误码不变(仍是 403 PERMISSION_DENIED),只换了一部分用户看到的句子;lint 只是 warning,但 `--strict` 流水线会因此失败。首方应用、示例、模板普查命中 0。回滚即还原本 PR,无迁移。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts` 的 `assertControlledByParentWrite`(判定与措辞分开的那一层)与 `callerReadsMasterReference`;`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 中复用 `cbpDetails` 的新规则段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/controlled-by-parent-master-reference-unreadable-refusal.test.ts`,预期 16 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地

## What changes

**The rule.** A write of a `controlled_by_parent` detail needs edit access to the master record its stored master reference names (ADR-0055 §3), whatever the writer may read. That decision is unchanged: the same writes are admitted and refused as before, with the same status and code.

**The refusal's wording follows the writer's field-level security on the master reference.**

- A writer who can read the detail's master reference keeps the specific refusal, word for word.
- A writer who cannot read it gets the same `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, for the same leg, with a sentence that names no master object, no master record and no leg: `… requires edit access to its master record (no edit permission on the parent record of this detail)`. The error's `details` carry the operation and the detail object only.
- "Can read" is the plugin's readable projection (`getReadableFields`), the field-level security the data plane's reads mask by, for the request's context (an on-behalf-of write intersects the delegator's mask there). When it cannot be resolved, or throws, the refusal takes the generic sentence.
- It covers every refusal the master-detail write check gives: the master's object permission, its row-level security, its record sharing, the chain legs above a master, and the owner rule of a row whose optional master is empty, on an update, a delete and a create. The served check (`checkControlledByParentWrite`) still names the same leg for both writers.

**New lint warning `security-controlled-by-parent-master-reference-hidden`** (`@objectstack/lint`, so `os lint`, `os validate` and the runtime save of a permission set or object, which reports a warning without refusing): a permission set whose field permission hides the master reference of a `controlled_by_parent` detail (`readable: false`). The finding states the rule and its consequence: the hidden field still decides each write of the detail by the set's holders, and a refused holder gets a refusal naming no master. It reuses the detail and master-reference recogniser the owner-policy arm already builds (`cbpDetails` over `resolveCbpRelation`), and is not reported beside the set's own View All or Modify All on the detail, which makes the mask inert (`security-superuser-field-mask-inert` reports that). `os explain` carries its entry. The id is exported as `SECURITY_CBP_MASTER_REFERENCE_HIDDEN`, the widening declared above.

A warning still fails a pipeline that runs `os lint --strict` or `os validate --strict`; the changeset says so.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-master-reference-unreadable-refusal.test.ts` (new, 16 tests): a real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` with the real security layer. Two writers whose sets differ only in `readable` on the references. For each leg (object permission, row-level security, record sharing, master chain, the optional-master owner rule, and a create naming the master): the hidden writer gets the same code and status and a sentence naming no master, no leg and no master id; the CONTROL writer gets the specific sentence. Also pinned: the same writes are admitted and refused for both writers, the served check names the same leg for both, and an unresolvable field-level read fails closed to the generic sentence.
- `packages/rest/src/data-controlled-by-parent-master-refusal-wording.test.ts` (new, 9 tests): the REST door (`PATCH /api/v1/data/:object/:id`, `POST /api/v1/data/:object`) over the real protocol, engine and security plugin. The hidden writer's 403 body carries no master name, leg or id on each leg; the CONTROL writer's carries today's specific text; both writers get the same status on each refused write and 200 on an editable master.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts`: a new describe block (positive, each set reported, unparsed entry read as parsed, optional master; CONTROLs: reference readable, another field hidden, no entry, object not a `controlled_by_parent` detail, detail not declared by the stack, the set's own View All), plus the reachability corpus entry and the push-site count (20 to 21).

## Acceptance notes

- Census of the new warning on first-party apps, examples and templates: 0 hits. The only `readable: false` field permissions in first-party sources are the showcase project's three budget fields and the identity-admin field group on `sys_user`; neither is a master reference of a `controlled_by_parent` detail.
- The lint stays at the warning tier as ruled; no other app is changed.
- "Can read" counts a partially masked reference as readable, because the readable projection keeps a masked column served (the same rule the export header follows). No first-party reference field carries a masking rule.

## Verification

<details><summary>Pins, ablation, suites</summary>

- At 880ca983a7: unit pins 16/16 passed, door pins 9/9 passed (against `@objectstack/plugin-security` rebuilt from this head; the built bundle carries the generic sentence, 1 hit each in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`).
- One-shot ablation of the readability branch (`callerReadsMasterReference` answering readable for everyone), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: 7 of 16 unit pins red, then restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), 16/16 green again.
- Full suites at 819609e4d3, the fix commit (the commits after it change only the two new test files, re-run above, and one docblock): `@objectstack/lint` 198 files / 8389 tests passed; `@objectstack/plugin-security` 256 of 257 files / 6172 tests passed, the one red file being the first version of the new unit file (fixture corrected in ef808cf6b1, 16/16 above); `@objectstack/rest` 400 of 401 files / 7665 tests passed, likewise the first version of the new door file (9/9 above). Typecheck exit 0 for all three packages, plugin-security and rest re-run at 880ca983a7.

</details>
